title: Arrived damaged and used!
text: Arrived damaged and used!. I’m very disappointed because I was looking forward to this. The candles arrived in a torn box, the box had smudges and clearly was used by someone else and the candle tins were dinted. The candles appear cheap looking and do not mirror those shown in the photograph. I probably could have excused all of the other issues but sending out a torn box, with damaged candles at Christmas was unforgivable. If I hadn’t checked this and gifted it to someone I would have been mortified when I saw them open it. Do not waste your money, set is worth 10 bucks at best!
